summary: Executed backend API regression and browser smoke tests for Streamflix home, search, details, demo player, profiles, My List, and responsive overflow.

integration_issues.issue: App initializes savedIds with m2 locally, but backend GET /api/watchlist starts empty; UI and API persistence are inconsistent after reload/session reset.

action_items: Hydrate savedIds from GET /api/watchlist (or seed backend consistently) so My List reflects the same source of truth after reload.
Fix the browser test error-detection snippet quoting if retained for automation.
critical_code_review_comments: Watchlist is in-memory demo state and is not MongoDB-backed despite the stated architecture; persistence is intentionally MOCKED.
Frontend ignores failed movie/watchlist API requests and silently falls back, which can hide integration failures.
Subscription/payment flow is MOCKED; no real payment is processed.
seed_data_creation: POSTed m2 to watchlist during test and removed it afterward; final backend watchlist is empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend 4/4 passed. Browser: home, mobile overflow, Neon search, details, details player open/close, profile Alex, desktop overflow, and remove toast passed. One browser run ended on an invalid second add selector after the list correctly became empty; error scan in first script had a test-script quoting syntax error.
rca of the issue: App.js initializes savedIds as new Set(["m2"]) but never GETs /api/watchlist. Backend WATCHLIST starts as an empty process-level set. Therefore the visible initial My List differs from backend state and will not be durable across reloads.
